done_when: The authority extractor inventories every statically reachable local operation from each registered entrypoint.
Submitted padding, node splitting, omission, source drift, and root escape return BLOCK.
Every extracted operation and external call has one authority-owned execution kind and taxonomy.
Aggregate and minimum-path weighted and unweighted deterministic ratios are each at least 0.85.
Every model operation has a typed positive budget and reachable CODE validator, fallback, and failure state.
Authenticated Gate-D approval binds one exact process, graph, proof, artifact, and action envelope.
Atomic approval consumption rejects replay and redirection.
Claude Code, Hermes, OMP, and Prime-Agent load and execute the same rule hash.
Planted RED, restored GREEN, synthetic Julie execution, and sealed proof all pass.
production_exclusions: No message, publish, deploy, push, merge, payment, destructive action, or private-data export.
No global agent-surface mutation before authenticated Gate-D and D85 proof.
rollback: Remove the D85 process registrations and shared hook bindings, then restore the prior versioned agent configs. Preserve all denial and consumption receipts.
